rationale: C04 supplies a concrete and unusually close template: two separately described disputes involving overlapping sets of carriers represented by the same three regional conference committees; separate carrier and labor-organization attachments labeled Lists A through D; the same plural-dispute findings; and the same thirty-day reporting and statutory status-quo provisions. The child adapts C04's wage and health-and-welfare disputes into updated 1960 demands while preserving the drafting architecture. C18 and C23 share the Akron-led, three-region carrier formulation and similar attachments, but lack C04's distinctive two-dispute, four-list structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS disputes exist between the Akron & Barberton Belt Railroad and other carriers represented by the Eastern, Western, and Southeastern Carriers' Conference Committees, designated in List A... employees... designated in List B...; and WHEREAS disputes exist... designated in List C... employees... designated in List D...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS disputes exist between the Albany Port District Railroad and other carriers represented by the Eastern, Western and Southeastern Carriers' Conference Committees, designated in list A... employees... designated in list B...; and WHEREAS disputes exist... designated in list C... employees... designated in list D...
shared_material.explanation: The child reproduces C04's distinctive paired-recital and four-attachment framework, changing the lead railroad and updating the subjects and participating entities.
